# Load Packages
```{r}
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(viridis)
library(ggnewscale)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

# Functions

```{r}
plot_rts_and_basemaps = function(uid) {
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = rts_imagery_correspondence |>
      filter(UID == uid),
    aes(color = as.factor(planet_basemap_year),
        linewidth = as.factor(planet_basemap_year)),
    fill = 'transparent'
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = 'Planet Basemap Year') +
  scale_linewidth_manual(name = 'Planet Basemap Year',
                         values = c(2.5, 2, 1.5, 1, 0.5)) +
  new_scale_color() +
  geom_sf(data = arts |>
            filter(UID == uid),
          aes(color = BaseMapDate)) +
  ggtitle(paste('UID =', uid))
}
```

# Load Data

```{r}
planet_grids = st_read('./data/planet_grids_for_arts_closest_year.geojson')
rts_imagery_correspondence = st_read('./data/rts_polygon_basemap_correspondence.geojson')
arts = st_read('../ARTS/ARTS_main_dataset/v.2.1.0/ARTS_main_dataset_v.2.1.0.geojson')
downloads = read_csv('./data/download/planet_basemap_downloads.csv')
world = rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")
world = world |>
  st_transform(3413) |>
  st_crop(planet_grids |>
            st_bbox() |>
            st_as_sfc() |>
            st_buffer(dist = 200000) |>
            st_bbox())
```

# Data Stats

```{r}
print(
  paste('The total number of images downloaded is', 
        nrow(planet_grids))
  )
```

```{r}
planet_grids_count = planet_grids |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            .by = c(geometry))
```

# Map of Downloads

```{r, fig.height=7.5, fig.width=6.5}
ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(
    data = world,
    color = 'transparent',
    # fill = '#EEFFDD',
    fill = 'white'
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = planet_grids_count,
    aes(color = n,
        fill = n),
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  # scale_color_viridis(name = 'N Years',
  #                     direction = -1) +
  # scale_fill_viridis(name = 'N Years',
  #                     direction = -1) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    name = 'Image\nCount',
    low = 'gray60',
    high = 'black'
    # low = '#6699FF',
    # high = '#000033'
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    name = 'Image\nCount',
    low = 'gray60',
    high = 'black'
    # low = '#6699FF',
    # high = '#000033'
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = world,
          color = 'gray20',
          fill = 'transparent') +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(
      # fill = '#DDEEFF'
      fill = 'gray90'
      ),
    panel.grid = element_line(
      # color = 'gray90
      color = 'gray80'
      ),
    legend.position = 'inside',
    legend.position.inside = c(0.998, 0.002),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0)
  )

# ggsave('./figures/planet_basemap_downloads.jpg')
```

Look for Missing Basemaps

```{r}
rts_imagery_correspondence = rts_imagery_correspondence |>
  mutate(
    n_tiles = n_distinct(id), 
    .by = c(UID, BaseMapDate)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_per_year = n(),
    .by = c(UID, BaseMapDate, planet_basemap_year)
  )
```

```{r}
View(
  rts_imagery_correspondence |> 
    filter(n_tiles != n_per_year) |>
    arrange(UID, planet_basemap_year)
  )
```

Get storage location for all the imagery tiles in question

```{r}
missing_basemaps = rts_imagery_correspondence |>
  filter(
    UID %in% c(
      'bf7f808c-7a3a-5794-9448-2ff4d71f0139',
      '011811cf-9b8c-5167-b151-331453254eee',
      '3cbbe4ee-99ab-5053-881f-bb782287735b',
      'c5a67692-36c1-5d59-a117-5cd628adf207',
      'ffa7a2b1-2f99-5c25-be39-28040038167d'
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(UID)

missing_basemap_locations = downloads |>
  mutate(
    file = str_split_i(filename, '/', i = 6),
    id = str_split_i(file, '_', i = 5),
    type = file |>
      str_split_i('_', i = 6) |>
      str_split_i('\\.', i = 1)
  ) |>
  filter(
    type == 'quad' & 
      id %in% unique((missing_basemaps |> 
                        pull(id)))
  )

st_write(missing_basemap_locations,
         './data/lost_imagery_locations.geojson')
```
